name: sailboat
caption: A sailboat with a hull, a cabin and one mast base. A hull carries a deck and a cabin; the bow and stern close it. Curved hull surfaces keep an even thickness along the keel. Overall width is 1.10 times depth; height is 0.55 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous blue, white, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
